hero.subtitle: Food & Beverages
hero.title: Yummy Yummy
hero.description: A perfect blend of local favorites and authentic dishes — from freshly cooked Shrimp Fried Noodles to mouth-watering Burritos. Served with the warmest hospitality in the heart of Legian, Bali.

about.subtitle: About Us
about.title: Comfort in Every Detail
about.description: Yummy Yummy is a casual restaurant that offers a warm and friendly atmosphere. We create a special place to enjoy delicious food, share stories, and feel right at home.

1.title: Casual & Cozy Atmosphere
1.description: Comfortable interior design with rustic-vintage touches and modern tropical vibes, perfect for relaxing and enjoying quality time.

2.title: Free Wi-Fi
2.description: Stable internet connection for light work, browsing, or staying connected with friends and family.

3.title: Signature Menu & Cocktails
3.description: A selection of signature drinks and fusion dishes that combine local and international flavors.

4.title: Flexible Opening Hours
4.description: Open daily from 08:00 to 22:00, ideal for breakfast, lunch, dinner, or simply unwinding.

5.title: Friendly for Everyone
5.description: Fully accessible with wheelchair-friendly access and comfortable seating for all guests.

6.title: Perfect for Groups & Travelers
6.description: Ideal for families, friends, and travelers visiting Legian, with warm and personal service.

reservation.subtitle: Reservation
reservation.title: We Look Forward to Welcoming You
reservation.description: Reserve a table with ease or check availability. Visit Yummy Yummy and enjoy a warm, relaxed dining experience filled with authentic flavors.

facilities.subtitle: Comfort & Facilities
facilities.title: Enhance Your Experience
facilities.description: We provide a range of facilities to ensure your dining experience is more comfortable, enjoyable, and memorable every time you visit.

1.title: Alcoholic Beverages Available
1.description: A selection of premium wines, beers, and cocktails for adult guests seeking a more complete dining experience.

2.title: Group-Friendly Layout
2.description: Flexible seating and space arrangements for large families, group gatherings, or corporate events.

3.title: Spacious Parking
3.description: A safe and spacious parking area for your convenience when arriving and leaving.

4.title: Kid-Friendly
4.description: Special kids menu, high chairs, and a safe atmosphere to keep children comfortable and happy.

5.title: Dine-in & Takeaway
5.description: Enjoy your meal at the restaurant or order takeaway to suit your preference.
